grammar.opener: Every raw group whose first literal character is q opens or continues a condition run. Payload is raw[1:]; empty payload is a separate unparseable-q diagnostic, not an excuse to remove a terminal q. No normalization/alternate-reader pooling.
grammar.scope: A maximal qrun has an overt non-q consequent before the next qrun or paragraph end. Bare groups before firstq are assertions. No implicit/previous-paragraph consequent, anacoluthon, question, lexical-q exception or omitted consequence in this fixed contract.
grammar.primary_universe: P blocks with BOTH own explicit start and end markers. Own right-only blocks reported separately; unmarked ends UNKNOWN. RF zero ownflags diagnostic only.
grammar.falsifier: Any primary complete block ending in one or more literal q-initial raw groups. Uncertainty and reader differences are preserved; manual assessment may qualify robustness but never remove registered raw cases.
grammar.not_required: No actual conditiontruth, wordmeaning, syllable/alphabet, source language, participant or semanticargument is asserted.
